entities.summary: Jessica Melbourne-Thomas is an Australian marine, Antarctic, and climate change scientist with the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation. Her research focuses on climate change, its effects on the marine environment, and how to adapt and response to these changes.
